# Edit Image Metadata

- Route: `/tools/edit-image-metadata`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `metadata`
- Slug: `edit-image-metadata`

## Summary

Set the title, author, copyright, keywords and description of a photo, fix or remove its GPS location, and rewrite EXIF and IPTC tags. (Metadata & privacy tools)

## Details

Photographers need a copyright notice and contact details in every file they deliver. Agencies want IPTC keywords and captions. Anyone sharing a photo may want the location gone, or set to a city rather than a doorstep. Media Manipulator rewrites EXIF, IPTC and XMP fields in place on our servers with ExifTool, keeps the image data untouched, and shows you the before-and-after diff.
### What it does
- Sets title, author/artist, description, copyright, comment and keywords.
- Removes the GPS location or replaces it with coordinates you choose.
- Edits individual EXIF/TIFF, IPTC and advanced tags by name.
- Keeps the pixels untouched; optionally converts the format in the same pass.
- Shows a diff of what changed after the job.
### How to use it
1. Upload an image: JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, TIFF.
2. Fill in the fields: Title, author, copyright, keywords, location.
3. Apply: ExifTool rewrites the tags on our servers.
4. Download: Compare before and after, then save.
### Supported formats
- Input: jpg, png, webp, gif, avif, heic, bmp, tiff
- Output: jpg, png, webp, avif, gif
### Technical details
- The custom metadata mode writes the standard EXIF (Artist, Copyright, ImageDescription), IPTC (Keywords, Caption) and XMP (dc:title, dc:creator) counterparts together so every viewer agrees.
- Replacing the GPS location writes GPSLatitude/GPSLongitude with the right reference hemispheres; removing it clears every GPS tag.
- PNG and WebP carry metadata in text chunks and XMP; the same fields are written there.
### Use cases
- Deliver client photos: Embed your name, copyright and contact in every file.
- Stock submissions: Add IPTC keywords and a caption.
- Coarse geotag: Replace a precise GPS fix with the city centre.
- Fix a wrong tag: Correct the author or date a scanner wrote.
### FAQ
Q: Will editing metadata re-encode my JPG?
A: Only if you change the output format or resize. With the same format and no edits to the pixels, the image data is copied and only the tags are rewritten.
Q: Can I remove the location but keep everything else?
A: Yes. Tick "remove location data" and leave the other fields untouched.
Q: Can I edit a tag that is not listed?
A: Yes. Expand the advanced section and set any EXIF or IPTC tag by name.
Q: How do I remove everything instead?
A: Use the Remove EXIF metadata tool, which strips every tag in one click.
